name: F_limit_REF_lower3
description: EXECUTION-MODEL CHANGE, not a signal change: while restricted and flat, a resting limit at the frozen level L (state and level frozen as of the prior close) fills at L when low <= L*sens, or at the open when open < L (gap-through); the order rests only when L <= 0.90 x prev-90-session high, so the dip condition holds at the limit price itself (the close-based 10% signal is not knowable intraday). Close-based entry path and all other rules unchanged. Runs outside the frozen engine in variant_sim.py (verified to reproduce the anchors trade for trade with the limit model off).
hypothesis: The historically missed V-bottom entries were execution artifacts of the same-close approximation: a resting limit would have filled intraday at the required level and captured the rebound.
